correctness.rationale: Positive coefficient weights β_{2^k j}=binom(j+k,k)^{-2} make z^n/√β_n an orthonormal basis and C(z^{2^k j}) a unilateral shift of weights (k+1)/(j+k+1), plus constant identity. The beta-product XY moment sequence equals squared weight products, giving a normal extension on every orbit and hence subnormality. Diagonal differences r_{j,k}²-r_{j,k-1}² produce the displayed rational d_{j,k}, bounded by 2/(j+k), proving positivity and compactness. For t→0 with x=tj,y=tk the limiting superlevel density is F=2xy/(x+y)^3; odd-j mesh contributes density 1/2. The counted lattice set lies in x+y<2, origin negligible, level boundary measure zero; ∫s²/(1+s)^6 ds = B(3,3)=1/30. This yields n^{1/2}s_n→1/√30 and Schatten p>2, weak 2 endpoint. Independently counted N(0.01)=335 and N(1/300)=3001; convergence is proved analytically, not from these tests. Inspected exact checker.py sampled moment ratios, inequalities and cutoff counts.
